name: Zhen Lian ~Jiyu Fengqiu~
source:
True Love ～Confide to the Maple～ is a romance visual novel set in modern-day China that tells the love story of high schoolers.

Although set in modern Chinese society, romantic relationships between teenagers are still restricted. However, what these lovers will experience is far greater than what they expect.

An accident changes their life and breaks their faith and promises.

Should they stick to their faith or choose real love? The decision depends on your heart.
In this game, you will get to experience high school life in China and the emotions of the young teenagers.

[Edited from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/495990/]Steam[/url]]
